blow_off_valve.source: [AS] TEST FIXTURE, not shipped data. Area ASSUMED, sized by a rule: the pair (2 x 460 mm2, Cd included) vents about half of the pair's max_mass_flow_kg_s 1.2 at 1.8 bar gauge: choked orifice m = A*p/sqrt(R*T)*0.685 with p 2.8 bar abs and T 294 K gives 0.6 kg/s. Crack 0.9 bar and full-open 1.6 bar (charge minus manifold pressure) ASSUMED by a rule: crack above the idle vacuum (ambient minus an idle manifold of ~0.3 bar = 0.7 bar) so the valve stays shut at idle and light load, full open when the throttle closes at 2+ bar charge (2.5 bar difference). Tau 40 ms ASSUMED.
